title: Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Enrolled in a degree program in CS or related field; experience in C++, Java, Python, or Go.
description: Work on real-world engineering problems across Google products and infrastructure alongside full-time software engineers.

title: Gates Cambridge Postgraduate Scholarship
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom applying to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at Cambridge.
salary: Full tuition fees + £20,000 annual maintenance allowance
qualification: Outstanding academic record, leadership potential, and commitment to improving the lives of others.
description: Fully-funded scholarship for outstanding international students to pursue postgraduate study at the University of Cambridge.

title: Software Engineer - Early Career
eligibility: Recent graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of professional software development experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline.
description: Build next-generation cloud services and AI products while collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams.

title: Frontend Engineer - Remote
eligibility: Open to candidates worldwide with professional frontend development experience.
qualification: Demonstrated experience with Vue.js, JavaScript, modern CSS/HTML, and Git workflows.
description: Develop and maintain user interfaces across the GitLab platform in a fully remote work environment.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with internet access; no prior programming experience required.
qualification: Beginner level; interest in computer science, algorithms, C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
description: An entry-level course teaching how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using modern web and software technologies.

title: Kaggle Machine Learning Competitions
eligibility: Open to students, researchers, data scientists, and ML enthusiasts worldwide.
qualification: Knowledge of data science, machine learning algorithms, Python, or R.
description: Solve complex real-world data science problems, build predictive models, and compete for cash prizes on Kaggle's global platform.
